ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 no-show cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher; no account action against the driver (no fake arrival confirmation was recorded).
ruling.reasoning:
The driver cancelled and claimed the rider was a no-show, so the case enters through NS-0 and is tested against NS-1 [F4][RD-NS-0]. The trace settles NS-1 (i) and (ii): the driver tapped "I'm Here" at 13:02:35 while 39 m from the pickup point (closest approach 38 m overall), so the arrival confirmation was genuine [F6][F1][RD-NS-1].

NS-1 (iii), however, fails. NS-1 default requires the driver to remain continuously within the pickup radius for more than 3 minutes after the arrival confirmation until cancelling; the record shows only 175 seconds (2 min 55 s) inside the radius after the 13:02:35 tap, against a 180-second threshold [F6][RD-NS-1]. The driver's own chat message "More than 3 min already, I have to cancel" at 13:05 asserts the contrary [F10], but the system timeline overrides statements, and the message supports this on its own terms too: only the 3-minute mark is claimed while the driver's own written statement was made after the trip, not part of the chat [F12][F10][RD-NS-1]. The wider figure of 4 min 30 s within 200 m from 13:01:00 [F2][F5] counts time before the "I'm Here" tap, which NS-1 expressly excludes. The gap between 13:02:15 and 13:05:30 was 40 m from the pickup and stationary [F3], which is inside the radius, but the metric that governs is the post-tap continuous window, and it falls short [F6][RD-NS-1].

Because the arrival confirmation was genuine (39 m at the tap), the NS-2 fraud branch does not apply and no account flag is triggered [F6][F1][RD-NS-2]. The concurrency of the driver's late cancellation and the rider's claim that she came out shortly after is not needed: one failed element is enough to defeat the fee [RD-NS-2].

The remedy is the full cancellation fee of $6.61 charged on the record; as a non-metered RydeX ride the fee is a fixed published amount, so the arithmetic is simply the recorded charge [F7][F4][RD-NS-2]. The refund is issued as a Ryde voucher, and Ryde retains final discretion [RD-NS-7].

Safety screen: I read both chat messages, the driver's written statement and the rider's complaint — no threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation appears; the messages are a pickup notice and a cancellation notice [F9][F10][F12][RD-SAFE-1]. Profile facts (rider clean, driver one prior no-show upheld) play no part in the outcome [F16][F17][RD-NS-1].
